clips.title: The story
paras: Vahlarriel Demonslayer has come to Desolace to learn what became of two missing nobles of House Malem, a Darnassian merchant family. Their father fears the worst, and the last word of the pair places them in the Stonetalon Mountains some weeks back. Vahlarriel asks you to find their wagon.

Vahlarriel Demonslayer is looking for Tyranis and Dalinda Malem, whose father fears the worst and has charged Vahlarriel with doing everything possible to find them. The search has barely begun, and Vahlarriel hopes it will not keep them in Desolace long. The pair were last reported crossing the Stonetalon Mountains some weeks ago. Vahlarriel asks you to find their wagon in Desolace and to come at once when you do. Its charred remains lie there, with a chest among them.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I am Vahlarriel, friend. I've come here to discover the whereabouts of two missing nobles of a Darnassian merchant family--House Malem. The father of the house fears the worst, and I am to do everything I can to find his missing children. I have yet to start my search for Tyranis or Dalinda, but I am hopeful I shall not be here long.
Last word tells of them passing through the Stonetalon Mountains a few weeks ago.
If you find their wagon, please, come find me immediately.

clips.title: Completion
paras: As you rummage around the remains of the wagon, it becomes obvious that it was attacked by both spells and weapons. The battle seemed one-sided and quick; there's no blood to be found, and no remains of any bodies.
Whoever attacked the wagon was efficient and swift.
